people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.
translations.bsb: He fell facedown at Jesus’ feet in thanksgiving to Him—and he was a Samaritan.
translations.kjv: And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.
